verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It introduces normalized affine barycentric coordinates valid for a nondegenerate triangle, derives the correct coordinate characterizations of the three cevian lines, proves necessity by multiplying the resulting nonzero coordinate ratios, and proves sufficiency by explicitly constructing a point satisfying all three line equations. Positivity of the side-segment lengths justifies every division. The statement is self-contained, no prohibited justification occurs, and there are no internal fact_id or external-paper references requiring validation.
